Williams' December 2025 fact sheet for Constitution cites data center and manufacturing construction as a reason the Northeast needs the pipeline. It says the Northeast got only 2 percent of national data center construction spending from 2020 to 2024. No specific data center is named.

Summit Midstream's August 2026 release on the Double E expansion names data center development in Texas and New Mexico as a new source of demand for Double E, beyond the expansion capacity to Waha. No specific data center is named. Trade press repeats the same statement.
DT Midstream added a new 250 million cubic feet per day interconnect on the NEXUS mainline to supply a gas plant that powers a new data center in Ohio. The data center is not named.

A January 2026 Rextag industry blog names data centers, with utilities, industry and coal retirements, as demand drivers for gas pipeline expansion in Wisconsin, and names the Wisconsin Reliability Project as one of the expansions meeting that demand. It says Microsoft and Meta, among others, are looking at Wisconsin and Illinois for data center sites. No specific data center is tied to this pipeline.

A Williams blog post from August 2024 says the Southeast Supply Enhancement project is designed to provide reliable power where data center growth is expected, and points to Virginia as the largest data center hub. A January 2026 release from Intensity Infrastructure Partners and Rainbow Energy Center says the decision to advance Phase I of the 36-inch pipeline supports sustained data center growth, grid reliability and industrial development in North Dakota. Uncommitted capacity supports new gas-fired power along the route and at Coal Creek Station. No specific data center is named.

Boardwalk's April 2025 release for the Borealis open season names data centers among the customers the project will serve. It lists electric utilities, power producers, gas utilities, producers, LNG exporters, industrial users and data centers. It describes data centers as driving the digital economy. No specific data center is named.
